run_spend_key_fn: run the spend_key_fn endpoint to view all API keys created, ordered by spend
run_spend_user_fn: run the spend_user_fn endpoint to view all users created, ordered by spend
run_view_spend_tags: run the view_spend_tags endpoint to view spend per request tag with optional date range
run_get_global_activity: run the get_global_activity endpoint to get daily API request counts and token usage over a date range
run_ui_view_spend_logs: run the ui_view_spend_logs endpoint to query paginated spend logs with filters for api_key, user_id, model, team_id, and date range
run_get_global_spend_report: run the get_global_spend_report endpoint to get daily spend grouped by team, customer, or api_key
run_calculate_spend: run the calculate_spend endpoint to calculate estimated cost before or after an LLM completion call
run_ui_view_session_spend_logs: run the ui_view_session_spend_logs endpoint to get paginated spend logs for a specific session_id
run_global_spend_per_team: run the global_spend_per_team endpoint to get daily spend grouped by team over the last 30 days
run_provider_budgets: run the provider_budgets endpoint to check current budget, spend, and reset time for each configured provider
